title: Provide additional information for a combat sports application
summary: This page provides instructions on how to submit additional information if your initial combat sports application was incomplete.
intro: If you have been asked to provide more information, it means that the information you provided did not meet the application requirements.
what_you_need: Your RAI (Request Additional Information) number (including all digits and letters)
The additional information you have been requested to provide

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required details and documents.
Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to provide the additional information.

internal_links.text: Apply for an industry participant and promoter registration

faqs.q: What should I do if I am unsure of the information I need to provide?
faqs.a: Contact the Combat Sports Authority on 13 13 02.

faqs.q: What do I need to provide additional information?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, your application or registration number, your RAI (Request Additional Information) number, and the additional information requested.

faqs.q: How do I submit the additional information?
faqs.a: Gather the required details and documents, select the 'Apply online' button, log in to your MyServiceNSW Account, and follow the prompts.
